description: Finds the postal codes of Georgian Post for an address, a street, a town, or a village of Georgia, by text in Georgian or English. Returns each matching address with its 4-digit postal code and its district. Georgian Post gives a postal code for each street in Tbilisi, Batumi, and Kutaisi only. For another town or a village, search its name. Data from the web page of Georgian Post.

language.description: The language of the addresses: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of addresses, 1 to 100. The default is 20.

query.description: An address, a street, a town, or a village of Georgia, in Georgian or English. 3 to 100 characters.

name: postal_search_codes

addresses.description: The matching addresses, in the order of Georgian Post.

address.description: The address as Georgian Post writes it: the settlement, then the street. A part in parentheses limits the postal code to some house numbers.

district.description: The city or the municipality under which Georgian Post groups the address.

postal_code.description: The postal code: 4 digits as a string. It can start with 0.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the postal codes, RFC 3339.

note.description: How to search again, when the list is empty.

source.description: The source of the data: Georgian Post.

stale.description: True when Georgian Post did not answer and the server returns postal codes it read before.

total.description: The count of addresses that Georgian Post matched. More than the count of addresses when the limit cut the list.

title: Search the postal codes of Georgia
